content: Yikusikidikisi ku thwala ya Nzambi yi ku thwala ya Kidisitu Yesu, wuna wabáfundisa batu ba moyu yi bamvumbi, yikulombibwa muna zina dya kudimonikisa kwa Kidisitu yi Kipfumu kyandi:
samuna Ndinga ya Nzambi, ata muna tangwa dya bukheti keti dya kakalakanu; bakwikisa, bakaya ho loni baheka kikesa, wabalongaka yi sipha dya mbundu dyosu.
Mukuma, tangwa dibati kwisa batu bazólaku kuyuka malongi ma kyedika, kaasi balánda tsambu za lutu lwa bawu amana badíhana kwena balongi ba lawu babásamwana mana bisi zola kuyuka.
Bapháta matu ma bawu ndangu bayukaku kyedika, bahúkumuka ku bingana-ngana.
Kaasi ngeyi, dikenga mu mambu moosu, tambwasa munyanga, mwangisa Musamu wa Bukheti, lungisa buna bufwanini kisalu kyaku.
Kwena meni, beka zola ni bandambula kimenga amana tangwa dyama dya kusisa tsi dilungi.
Ndwaniki muzingu wa bukheti, thudini ku tsuka ya thinu, tsimbididilwa lukwikilu.
Amana buthwena, mukhonzi wa masonga bátswekilawa: Pfumu, zusi wa masonga, kaphékawa kilumbu meni kyakina, amana ka kwena meni ku lwesi, kaasi yi kwena babana boosu bisi zola kudimonikisa kwandi.
Milongi mya tsuka
Sya ngolu wisa ngwana tswatsu.
Kikuma Temasi wáthina, mudyambu dya lungongu lwa mambu ma buthwena ma tsi yayi; wendi ku Tesalonika; Khelesasi kakwénda ku Ngalatiya, amana Titi kakwénda ku Talamati
Luka lwesi yenina yandi. Munata Malaku amana wisa yandi, mukuma mupfunu wa lawu yenina yandi kikuma kya kisalu.
Yimutumikini Tisiki ku Efesu.
Ha wakwísa, wandatina kazaka kana tsitsiki ku Tholowasi kwena Kadiphusu; amana wandatina phi mikanda, theti-theti mikanda mina báyidikila yi mikanda mya bambisi.
Lekizandi wuna wenina mbembu, mbi ya lawu káphanga; Pfumu kamuvutwala bwosu bwenina mihangu myandi
Dikenga kwena yandi, ngeyi phi, mukuma kázolazoku keti koma ndinga zetu.
Tangwa yísamba mbala ya theti ha bápfunda, yímonaku mutu wátsadisa: batu boosu bándosila. Yambula Nzambi kabatangilamoku!

Kaasi Pfumu wángyakidila amana wápheka ngolu zilutini, ndangu, muna nzila ya meni, Musamu wa Buketi basamunawa buna bufwani amana baba bakondi kala Bayuta boosu bayukawa. Amana wáphulula ku munwa wa thambu.
Pfumu kaphúlula hika ku kosu kisalu kya mbi amana kakhótisa konda kifu muna Kipfumu kyandi kya mazilu. Khembu yakala kwena yandi mvula yi mvula! Abwabuna!
Mboti ya tsuka
Muheka mboti Phisikila yi Akilasi, yi nzu ya Onezifodi.
Elasiti wusadiki ku Khoditu, amana yimusisikini Thofimi wabela kuna Mile.
Sya ngolu wisa buna khaniku kedi disa tangwa dya kyosi kya ngolu. Ebulusu, Phundesi, Dinusi, Koloti yi baphangi boosu mboti bakuhekini.
Pfumu kakala yi kitembu kya ngeyi. Khenda za Nzambi zakala yi benu!
